mapper.insert: insert into operation_log (description, operator_id, request_method, request_uri, client_ip, cost_time, create_time) values (#{description}, #{operatorId}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{clientIp}, #{costTime}, #{createTime})

sql.if: and (ol.description like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or e.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or ol.request_uri like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: select max(ol.id) from operation_log ol left join employee e on ol.operator_id = e.id
select count(*) from operation_log ol left join employee e on ol.operator_id = e.id ol.id <= #{maxId}
